description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling DeleteFeatureProperty commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates logic to extract a feature from a Thing, delete a specified property, generate corresponding events and responses, and manage entity tags for concurrency control.
external_methods: FeaturePropertyDeleted.of(ThingId, String, JsonPointer, long, long, DittoHeaders, Metadata) : ThingEvent

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyStrategy
classes.description: Implements a command strategy for deleting a feature property within a Thing, handling event creation, property removal, and entity tag management.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete property command by extracting the feature, deleting the property, and generating appropriate events or errors.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the specified feature from the provided Thing, throwing an error if the feature is not found.

methods.name: getDeleteFeaturePropertyResult
methods.description: Creates the event and response for a successful property deletion, or generates an error result if the property is not found.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Gets the entity tag representing the previous state of the feature before modification, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional, indicating no specific next entity tag is associated after deletion.
